in_sanskrit.name: देवो
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Devo' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'देव' (Deva), which means 'God' or 'Deity'. In Hinduism, 'Deva' is used to refer to the gods and goddesses, who are believed to have created and govern the universe. The name 'Devo' is a respectful and reverential name for a male being, signifying divinity and holiness.

in_hindi.name: देवो
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Devo' in Hindi is the same as its Sanskrit counterpart, 'देवो' (Devo), which means 'God' or 'Deity'. In Hindi, the name is also written as 'देव' (Dev), and is used to refer to the Hindu gods and goddesses, as well as to respectful and reverential male names.

in_tamil.name: தேவோ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name 'Devo' in Tamil is derived from the Tamil words 'தேவம் (Thevam)' which means 'God' or 'Deity', and 'ஓ (O)', which is a suffix used to denote respect and reverence. Therefore, the name 'Devo' in Tamil signifies 'Respectful God' or 'Revered Deity'.
